parent.p52_science: frozen DEV FAIL 0/3, trained REINFORCE policies never probe

hypothesis: P52 failure is not absence of learnable factual information: a conventional Gaussian measurement model estimated only from actual randomly executed probe outcomes and final executed-action net rewards will learn positive net value of diagnostic information on unused, unfamiliar development worlds, while original policy-gradient controllers can still collapse.

source.law: Original P52 binary latent theta +/-1, cue=theta*cue_gain+cue_sigma*eps_c, optional diagnostic=theta*probe_gain+probe_sigma*eps_p, executed final action +/-1, actual reward=theta*action-cost*probe
source.fit_logging_policy: fair 50% executed probes, independent fair executed final signed actions; *only* measured diagnostic if executed; physically observed net reward after final action; source latent sign and unexecuted measurement excluded from fitted-model interface
source.same_fit_worlds: Original P52 on-policy learner sees the same fitting physical contexts and potential diagnostic opportunities but may execute different probes. It is NOT an equal count of realized exploratory probes; report counts and do not claim sample-efficiency superiority.
source.source_first_use: new authored DEV only, not independent externally admitted science

candidate.model: conventional fitted symmetric Gaussian cue and probe likelihoods; infer hidden sign from the algebraic identity (actual net reward+executed diagnostic cost)/executed final action; OLS estimate signal-gain scale and residual variance in physically observed normalized cues and the subset of actually probed normalized diagnostics; estimate theta prior frequency from recovered signed rewards
candidate.decision: compute learned Bayesian posterior from cue and empirical Gaussian params, predict expected reward improvement from physical diagnostic using normal CDF and visible cost; execute probe only if expected improvement exceeds cost; final action selected from posterior incorporating only actual executed probe measurement
prohibited: no true theta access in fitting function
no direct unexecuted measurement in fitting function
no generative parameter reference from source in fit
no true model scale or noise fixed at 1 in model fit
no source seed retuning after test

controls.analytic_bayes: known-model-aware P52 Gaussian Bayes, privileged reference ceiling
controls.never: conventional learned cue-only posterior using SAME fitted cue likelihood and no probes
controls.always: conventional learned posterior with every physical probe, pay all costs
controls.simple: original P52 fixed confidence rule with model-aware posterior
controls.original_REINFORCE_MLP: original exact P52 FactorizedPolicy, 902 parameters, 700 AdamW updates on new fit source
controls.original_REINFORCE_GRU: original P52 ConventionalGRUPolicy, 954 parameters, 700 AdamW updates on new fit source
controls.wrong_return_credit: original P52 wrong-credit reference optional 700 updates same fit seed; if expensive report not run

train.three_disjoint_fit_partition_models: train empirical likelihood separately on FIT slices [0:29866],[29866:59733],[59733:89600] as uncertainty diagnosis and full FIT as primary
train.quantization: float64 numpy OLS with source only observed actual events

primary.min_net_gain_vs_factual_never: empirical learned VOI net reward >= learned-never +0.02 on both OOD1 and OOD2
primary.to_known_model_reference: empirical learned VOI OOD net reward >= analytic Bayes -.02 on both OOD1 and OOD2
primary.actual_probe_fraction: at least .05 and at most .95 on OOD1, OOD2
primary.weak_cue_cost_sensitivity: low cost probe rate >= high cost probe rate +.15 within low-cue & strong-probe-gain groups if both groups size>=25

secondary: paired reward delta and approximate 95% bootstrap CI vs learned never (seed 830901, fixed 2000 resamples)
fitted Gaussian signal scale and residual variance; train probe count
trained REINFORCE MLP/GRU original heldout reward and actual probe rate each seed
cold reconstruction from fitted sufficient statistics exact
fit and inference wall seconds and probe count
metrics.scientific_positive: IMPOSSIBLE because source is authored toy and model uses analytically assumed Gaussian noise family, not neural architecture superiority or authentic independent physics

audit.label_reconstruction: fully observed reward in this simulator algebraically reveals signed theta AFTER the final action; this makes conventional supervised fitting possible but is a narrow assumption not realistic general reward-learning
audit.no_oracle_leakage: training reward must be from an executed physical action; never read source theta from the fit data
